# Kelp Horn

> Kelp Horn is a free app (iOS and Android) with a live map and push alerts for whale sightings around Hermanus and the Overberg, Western Cape, South Africa. Sightings are posted by locals who watch Walker Bay. Anyone signed in can post, and an admin checks sightings from new posters before they go on the map, so an alert means whales. No ads, and no account needed to view the map or get alerts.

Key facts:

- What it answers: "Are there whales in Hermanus right now, and where?"
- How it works: a sighting is a pin at one of 25 shore viewing spots: 21 in Hermanus from Vermont to Grotto, and 4 at Gansbaai and De Kelders. It stays bright for 90 minutes after whales were last seen, then goes grey, and the map starts fresh at midnight. An empty map means no whales have been reported today.
- Alerts: push notifications per area, the moment a sighting goes on the map.
- Confirmations: anyone signed in can tap "Yes I saw", which keeps the sighting bright.
- Sharing: one tap sends a sighting to WhatsApp with a link to the live map.
- Season: southern right whales are usually in Walker Bay from about June to December, most from about August to October. Humpback and Bryde's whales, dolphins and occasionally orcas are seen too.
- Price: free, no ads, no in-app purchases.
- Privacy: no analytics or ad tracking. Location never leaves the phone. Data is stored in the EU (Frankfurt).
- Who makes it: h360.dev, Hermanus, South Africa. An independent project, not connected to Hermanus Tourism or any tour operator.
- Availability: [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6820970192) and [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.h360.kelphorn).

## Pages

- [Home](https://kelphorn.h360.dev/): what the app does, with a FAQ
- [Whale watching in Hermanus from land](https://kelphorn.h360.dev/whale-watching-hermanus/): the 21 Hermanus shore viewing spots west to east, plus Gansbaai and De Kelders, when to come, and tips
- [Privacy policy](https://kelphorn.h360.dev/privacy/): what is collected, where it's kept, and how to delete it
